description: This file declares the GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient class, which implements a web audio player client using GStreamer. It includes method declarations for controlling playback, handling samples, and managing state, as well as callback structures and necessary includes.

classes.name: WebAudioSinkCallbacks
classes.description: A structure holding callback functions for error, end-of-stream, and state change notifications.

classes.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: A class implementing a web audio player client using GStreamer, providing methods for controlling playback, handling samples, and managing state.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with provided callbacks.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Extracts sample info from GStreamer caps and opens the web audio stream.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the backend is open.

methods.name: notifyNewSample
methods.description: Handles a new sample buffer from GStreamer.

methods.name: notifyPushSamplesTimerExpired
methods.description: Handles timer expiry for pushing samples.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies a change in playback state.

methods.name: pushSamples
methods.description: Performs the next push operation of samples.

methods.name: isNewConfig
methods.description: Checks if the current config differs from the stored one.
